title: ResearchAccessContextV1
description: FND-002 task 2: the verified internal research access context (document 10 section 2.4, document 08 section 11). Minted by the KAG gateway or an authorized control-plane service, carried on the wire as X-Research-Context: Bearer <JWS>, and verified by every consuming service. It is a short-lived credential, never persisted as long-wait state.

x-datacompany-cross-field.name: context_validity_is_non_empty
x-datacompany-cross-field.$comment: Document 13 section 9.3: 'Missing, expired or conflicting context fails closed.' A context whose expiry is at or before its request instant is already expired at issue, so the interval must be non-empty. Declared at the ROOT and scoped `relative` (D3, option B), so the interval is checked wherever this context is composed, not only when it is validated as its own schema_ref.

$comment: SPEC CONFLICT, resolved and recorded as IMP-DEC-FND002-001 in config/foundation-decisions.json. The illustrative JSON at document 10 section 2.4 spells the scope-dependent members 'uuid-or-null'. Document 16 section 3.1 states 'A nullable tenant ID must not be used to distinguish them', and shared foundation section 4.1 states the conditional as required-iff-tenant / forbidden-iff-global. The general prohibition wins: this schema composes the SAME released resource_scope_conditional every canonical reference composes, so the discrimination is byte-identical at every nesting depth and no nullable tenant ID exists anywhere in the contract.

role_token.$comment: Authorization role granted to the actor. Reuses the released canonical type token so the pre-ADR regulatory denylist guard applies here too: a role may not activate a regulatory type before ADR-DATACOMPANY-REGULATORY-MODEL is accepted.

entitlement_token.$comment: Entitlement granted to the actor tenant. Same released token, same regulatory guard.

data_class_token.$comment: Data classification the request is authorized to touch. Same released token, same regulatory guard.

idempotency_key.$comment: Opaque client-supplied request key. Opaque means opaque: no structure is asserted and none may be inferred.

global_scope_forbids_context_ownership.$comment: Document 10 section 2.4: 'For resource_scope: global, resource tenant, workspace and project are null and writes require platform-curator authority.' Read together with the no-nullable-discriminator rule, a global context carries no workspace or project at all. resource_tenant_id is already handled by the released resource_scope_conditional and is deliberately not restated here.

context_extension.$comment: Declared composition point. A profile or pack extension adds namespaced members here and re-seals with unevaluatedProperties:false. Document 16 section 2.5: an extension MUST NOT weaken tenant, rights, provenance, approval or history constraints.

context_fields.$comment: REQUIRED SET is a local decision, IMP-DEC-FND002-002. Document 08 section 11 says only 'the applicable subset of', and document 13 section 9.3 pushes per-operation requiredness onto each service ('Each service validates the applicable subset for its operation; a missing required protocol, pack, role, purpose or request-binding field fails closed'). The twelve required here are the members that have no operation-independent reading: an actor, its tenant, the resource scope, the authorization vectors, the purpose, the policy revision, the request-binding trio and the validity window. protocol_version_id, workspace_id, project_id, profile_ref, pack_refs, initiated_by, delegation_id and idempotency_key are operation-dependent and are therefore optional HERE and required by the consuming operation's own schema.

actor_id.$comment: Verified authenticated subject. Never a body or header override (document 13 section 9.3).

actor_tenant_id.$comment: The actor's HOME tenant, which is not necessarily the resource tenant: an external collaborator retains their home identity and receives an explicit workspace grant into the resource-owner tenant (document 10 section 2.4).

workspace_id.$comment: The collaboration boundary. Present only for a tenant-scoped context.

project_id.$comment: The research boundary inside a workspace. Present only for a tenant-scoped context.

protocol_version_id.$comment: Exact protocol version this request runs under. Document 16 section 5.4: every lock, decision, job, analysis, model run and publication MUST pin the exact ProtocolVersion.

profile_ref.$comment: The active solution-profile release. Required when a profile affects meaning or validation (document 16 section 3.2), which is an operation-level condition, so it is optional in the envelope.

pack_refs.$comment: The exact capability-pack releases in force. Document 13 section 9.3 requires a verifier to check 'exact pack_refs'.

policy_version.$comment: The authorization-policy revision this context was evaluated against. Document 13 section 9.3: a continuation reauthorizes against CURRENT policy, so a stale policy_version cannot be replayed.

initiated_by.$comment: The human who initiated the work, retained separately from the acting subject so a service-principal continuation cannot erase the initiating actor (document 08 section 11).

delegation_id.$comment: The delegation chain entry that authorizes acting on another subject's behalf.

expires_at.$comment: Short-lived by construction. The non-empty interval is enforced by the root cross-field rule, which JSON Schema cannot express.
